item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip: Hold use to charge, release to smash
item.btmi.exclamation_mark.tooltip2: Hitting a block shatters blocks around it and sends out a shockwave; the longer the charge, the larger the area (capped)
item.btmi.dash.tooltip1: Left click: the staff splits into a blade and its sheath
item.btmi.dash.tooltip2: Right click: fire a light orb, lightning strikes on impact
item.btmi.dash.tooltip3: Sneak + hold attack: charge, then leap forward with a slash
item.btmi.dash.tooltip4: Hits build energy; at 10 stacks press %s to unleash Myriad Projection
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip1: Left click: extend the light blade from the cross
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip2: Sneak + right click: summon a floating sentinel, the weapon turns into Recall Obelisk
item.btmi.obelisk.tooltip3: Main and off hand can both summon one; the two sentinels act independently
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip1: Left click: the sentinel thrusts forward and rams the target
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip2: Hold right click: the sentinel keeps firing laser bolts
item.btmi.obelisk_recall.tooltip3: Press %s: the sentinel darts forward and detonates, destroying itself
item.btmi.colon.tooltip1: Right click: open the six-chamber cylinder, any bullet can be loaded (duplicates allowed)
item.btmi.colon.tooltip2: Left click: fire the bullet in the selected chamber
item.btmi.colon.tooltip3: Hold %s: open the bullet selection wheel
item.btmi.colon.tooltip4: Each bullet type behaves differently; see the bullet tooltips
item.btmi.high_explosive_bullet.tooltip: Explodes on impact and can break blocks
item.btmi.incendiary_bullet.tooltip: Ignites the surrounding area and sets targets on fire
item.btmi.paralysis_bullet.tooltip: Leaves the target frozen in place for a few seconds
item.btmi.piercing_bullet.tooltip: Higher damage, passes through a hit target and keeps flying
item.btmi.cryo_bullet.tooltip: Freezes and heavily slows creatures in the area
item.btmi.seeker_bullet.tooltip: Locks onto the nearest target and curves toward it
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip1: Left click: fire, right click: switch firing mode
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip2: %s: spin once to draw an energy ring, which then pulses outward for damage
item.btmi.crimson_fang.tooltip3: Burst: rapid shots; Laser: instant hitscan beam; Shotgun: short-range lightning fan
